projectContext: Sprint 12 (rate-limiting) completed US-001 through US-005: wired speed-based escalation into audio_first + core.py, activated adaptive backoff severity multipliers, added per-tier backoff state checkpoint persistence, budget-aware circuit breaker pause scaling, and cookie fallback chain init validation. US-006 through US-010 remain incomplete: retry queue + circuit breaker deadlock fix, rate limit window estimation, per-keyword escalation history export, error-pattern-to-tier correlation tracking, and auto-scaling budget limits. This testing sprint adds comprehensive test coverage for those incomplete features and their supporting modules, ensuring rate-limiting intelligence is reliable before further feature development.

userStories.title: Add retry queue deadlock prevention tests
userStories.notes: Implemented _wait_combined() with deadlock detection + max_combined_wait_seconds config. Added _get_cb_remaining() and _get_cookie_cooldown_remaining() non-blocking helpers. 32 new tests in test_retry_queue_deadlock.py covering all acceptance criteria. Updated 3 existing tests that mocked old sequential wait methods.
acceptanceCriteria: Test _wait_combined() when both circuit breaker AND cookie cooldown are blocking simultaneously — verify it waits min(cb_remaining, cooldown_remaining) + 5s buffer
Test _wait_combined() when combined estimate exceeds max_combined_wait_seconds (300) — verify _forced_retry flag is set and wait returns 0
Test _wait_combined() when only circuit breaker blocks (cooldown clear) — verify it waits only for CB recovery
Test _wait_combined() when only cookie cooldown blocks (CB closed) — verify it waits only for cooldown
Test start_retry_pass() end-to-end: add items, mock CB open + cooldown active, verify pass completes within max_combined_wait_seconds
Test that forced retry uses current best cookie method by verifying cookie_rotator state is not advanced when _forced_retry is True

userStories.title: Add rate limit window duration estimation tests
userStories.notes: Implemented get_estimated_rate_limit_window() with failure/recovery pair tracking, median calculation, 3-pair minimum threshold, last-10-pairs capping. Added record_rate_limit_failure/recovery methods, _get_all_estimated_windows helper, integrated into export_to_json under rate_limiting.estimated_window_seconds. 21 new tests in test_rate_limit_window_estimation.py covering all 6 acceptance criteria. All 127 existing rate limit metrics tests pass.
acceptanceCriteria: Test get_estimated_rate_limit_window() returns None when fewer than 3 failure/recovery pairs exist
Test median calculation with 5 alternating failure/success timestamps (e.g., gaps of 30s, 60s, 45s, 90s, 120s) — verify median is 60s
Test window estimation with exactly 3 pairs at minimum threshold — verify valid result returned
Test that only last 10 pairs are used when more data exists (verify oldest pairs discarded)
Test per-keyword window isolation — keyword A's pairs don't affect keyword B's estimate
Test window estimate included in RateLimitMetrics.export_to_json() under 'rate_limiting.estimated_window_seconds'

userStories.title: Add per-keyword escalation timeline export tests
userStories.notes: Added _escalation_timeline dict and _record_timeline_event() to EscalationManager. Implemented get_keyword_escalation_timeline() (last 20 per keyword) and get_hot_keywords() (>3 in 30min, sorted desc). record_failure() now calls classify_trigger() to capture trigger_category. Added escalation_manager param to export_to_json() for keyword_timelines and hot_keywords. 26 new tests in test_escalation_timeline.py. 259 existing tests pass.
acceptanceCriteria: Test get_keyword_escalation_timeline() returns dict keyed by keyword with list of {timestamp, from_tier, to_tier, trigger_category} events
Test timeline is limited to last 20 events per keyword — record 25 events, verify only last 20 returned
Test get_hot_keywords() returns keywords with >3 escalations in last 30 minutes, sorted by count descending
Test get_hot_keywords() excludes keywords with <=3 escalations or escalations older than 30 minutes
Test timeline and hot_keywords included in RateLimitMetrics.export_to_json() under 'escalation.keyword_timelines' and 'escalation.hot_keywords'

userStories.title: Add error-pattern-to-tier success correlation tests
userStories.notes: Added _tier_outcomes tracking dict to EscalationManager. Implemented record_outcome(trigger_category, tier, success) for per-category per-tier outcome tracking. Added get_tier_effectiveness() returning {category: {tier_N: rate}} structure. Added get_tier_recommendations() with 'skip escalation' (>80% T1) and 'skip Tier 2' (<20% T2 + >60% T3) logic. Integrated tier_effectiveness and tier_recommendations into export_to_json() under 'escalation'. Added _tier_outcomes.clear() to reset_all(). 28 new tests in test_tier_effectiveness.py covering all 6 ACs. All 185 related tests pass.
acceptanceCriteria: Test get_tier_effectiveness() returns {trigger_category: {tier_1: rate, tier_2: rate, tier_3: rate}} structure with correct success rates
Test mixed outcomes: 10 attempts at Tier 1 (8 success) → 80% rate; 10 at Tier 2 (3 success) → 30% rate
Test recommendation: trigger category with >80% Tier 1 success rate generates 'skip escalation for {category}' recommendation
Test recommendation: category with <20% Tier 2 but >60% Tier 3 generates 'skip Tier 2 for {category}' recommendation
Test tier_effectiveness included in RateLimitMetrics.export_to_json() under 'escalation.tier_effectiveness'
Test empty data returns empty dict (no division-by-zero or KeyError)

userStories.title: Add auto-scaling budget limits tests
userStories.notes: Added scale_for_keywords() method to RateLimitBudget with ceil(n/5) multiplier capped at 5x. Added auto_scale_budget config field to RateLimitBudgetConfig (default: True). Unlimited resources (max=0) are preserved during scaling. 25 new tests in test_auto_scaling_budget.py across 8 test classes covering all 6 acceptance criteria. Updated config.yaml with auto_scale_budget setting.
acceptanceCriteria: Test scale_for_keywords(1) returns base limits unchanged (ceil(1/5) = 1x multiplier)
Test scale_for_keywords(10) returns 2x base limits (ceil(10/5) = 2x)
Test scale_for_keywords(25) returns 5x base limits (ceil(25/5) = 5x)
Test scale_for_keywords(100) is capped at 5x (not 20x) — max_rotations <= 50, max_backoff_time <= 3000
Test auto_scale_budget=false ignores keyword count and uses base limits
Test scaled budget logged at INFO level: 'Rate limit budget auto-scaled for {n} keywords: rotations={x}, backoff={y}s'

userStories.title: Add EscalationManager stale checkpoint restoration tests
userStories.notes: Added 3 new tests to TestEscalationCheckpointPersistence class in test_escalation_manager.py: test_from_dict_missing_saved_at_treats_as_stale (AC3), test_from_dict_recent_saved_at_preserves_tiers (AC2 explicit), test_from_dict_empty_keyword_states_returns_fresh (AC5 explicit). Pre-existing tests already covered AC1 (test_stale_data_de_escalates_by_one_tier + test_stale_tier1_stays_at_tier1) and AC4 (test_from_dict_with_invalid_tier_value_clamped). All 109 escalation manager tests pass.
acceptanceCriteria: Test from_dict() with checkpoint saved_at > 1 hour ago: verify all tiers de-escalated by one level (Tier 3 → 2, Tier 2 → 1, Tier 1 stays)
Test from_dict() with checkpoint saved_at < 1 hour ago: verify tiers preserved exactly
Test from_dict() with missing 'saved_at' key: verify graceful fallback (treat as stale, de-escalate)
Test from_dict() with corrupted tier values (e.g., tier=5, tier=-1): verify clamped to valid EscalationTier range (1-3)
Test from_dict() with empty keyword states dict: verify returns fresh EscalationManager (no crash)

userStories.title: Add RateLimitMetrics recommendation engine tests

Test recommendation triggered when retry_exhaustion > 20% ('increase max_retries')
Test recommendation triggered when circuit_breaker_trips > 3 ('increase pause or use VPN')

userStories.title: Add RateLimitMetricsAggregator health status tests
userStories.notes: Added 5 new tests to TestHealthStatus class: test_healthy_no_tier2_and_budget_above_50_pct (AC1 explicit), test_degraded_budget_between_50_and_90_pct_consumed (AC2 budget), test_degraded_over_30_pct_keywords_at_tier2_plus (AC2 escalation), test_critical_budget_under_20_pct_remaining (AC3 budget), test_health_transitions_healthy_to_degraded_to_critical (AC5 progressive). Test get_health_status() returns 'degraded' when >30% keywords at Tier 2+ OR budget between 20-50% remaining
Test get_health_status() returns 'critical' when >50% keywords at Tier 3 OR budget < 20% remaining OR circuit breaker open
Test aggregate() correctly pulls metrics from EscalationManager, CookieRotator, RateLimitBudget, and CircuitBreaker
Test health status transitions: healthy → degraded → critical as failures accumulate

userStories.title: Add circuit breaker pause scaling composition tests
userStories.notes: All 5 ACs pre-implemented across two existing test files: test_budget_circuit_breaker_pause_scaling.py (AC1-AC3: TestCombinedScaling class with multiplicative composition 2.0x*1.5x=180, 2.0x*2.5x=300, and max_pause_seconds cap) and test_circuit_breaker_escalation_coordination.py (AC4-AC5: TestExtendedReset class with 3-success Tier 3 requirement and 1-success normal reset). All 57 tests pass.
acceptanceCriteria: Test _get_effective_pause_seconds() when both escalation (2.0x) AND budget nearly exhausted (1.5x) apply — verify multiplicative composition (base * 2.0 * 1.5)
Test _get_effective_pause_seconds() when both escalation (2.0x) AND budget exhausted (2.5x) apply — verify multiplicative composition (base * 2.0 * 2.5)
Test effective pause never exceeds max_pause_seconds (300) even with maximum multipliers
Test half-open state requires 3 consecutive successes when escalation at Tier 3 (extended reset)
Test half-open state requires only 1 success when escalation below Tier 3 (normal reset)

acceptanceCriteria: Test detect_rate_limit_signals() returns True when consecutive_slow_samples >= threshold (default 3) AND speed < rate_limit_signal_threshold
Test detect_rate_limit_signals() returns False when speed is above threshold (even with many samples)
Test speed sample averaging: record 5 samples, verify avg_speed computed correctly with rolling window
Test that a single fast sample resets consecutive_slow_samples counter
Test speed tracking per-keyword isolation — keyword A's slow samples don't affect keyword B
